description: Lightweight lookup index for all 27 Egyptian governorates and signature special places, supporting NEST Stage B experience design and architectural render generation.

cairo.name: Cairo
cairo.climate_zone: Hot desert with Nile river breeze; spring Khamaseen dust winds
cairo.prevailing_wind: N / NE (evening river breeze); S/SW in spring Khamaseen
cairo.nature_hero: Nile River Corridor & Limestone Desert Canyons
cairo.craft_hook: Khayamiya appliqué, copper engraving, mashrabiya joinery
cairo.render_cues: Golden afternoon sun grazing cream limestone, geometric wood-screen shadows, cool river-mist dawn

giza.name: Giza
giza.climate_zone: Dry desert plateau bordering humid Nile palm belt
giza.craft_hook: Harrania natural-dyed wool tapestries, Kerdasa handloom weaving
giza.render_cues: Crisp high-contrast desert light, stepped stone silhouettes over lush palm canopies, warm ochre sunset haze

qalyubia.name: Qalyubia
qalyubia.craft_hook: Historic brick river-arch masonry, agricultural orchard heritage
qalyubia.render_cues: Lush emerald orchard shade, dappled light through giant banyan leaves, red-brick arches reflecting in calm canals

alexandria.name: Alexandria
alexandria.climate_zone: Semi-arid Mediterranean; mild rainy winters (180-200mm), breezy humid summers
alexandria.prevailing_wind: NW Etesian sea breeze; winter Nawa storm surges
alexandria.nature_hero: Mediterranean Sea Edge, Tide Pools & Lake Mariout
alexandria.craft_hook: Traditional wooden felucca/trawler boatbuilding in Anfoushi, stone carving
alexandria.render_cues: Crisp Mediterranean blue with whitecap spray, sunlit pale cream limestone, deep north-facing shaded arcades

matrouh.name: Matrouh
matrouh.climate_zone: Mediterranean arid coast with winter rain-fed inland steppes
matrouh.nature_hero: Turquoise Limestone Bays & Rain-Fed Fig Orchards
matrouh.craft_hook: Awlad Ali Bedouin wool klim rugs, Roman rainwater cisterns
matrouh.render_cues: Blind-white sand meeting vivid turquoise water, low wind-hugging limestone terraces, golden coastal glow

beheira.name: Beheira
beheira.climate_zone: Humid western Delta transitioning to dry salt-lake desert edge
beheira.nature_hero: River-to-Desert Seam, Lake Edku & Alkaline Salt Lakes
beheira.craft_hook: Rosetta patterned brickwork, desert monastic mudbrick domes, palm basketry
beheira.render_cues: Warm terracotta-and-black brick patterns, lush citrus & palm groves, shimmering pink-white salt flats

kafr_el_sheikh.name: Kafr El-Sheikh
kafr_el_sheikh.nature_hero: Lake Burullus Wetlands & Africa-Eurasia Bird Flyway
kafr_el_sheikh.craft_hook: Shallow wooden lagoon-skiff building, reed-mat weaving
kafr_el_sheikh.render_cues: Mirror-still brackish water at dawn, golden swaying reed beds, slender post-supported timber piers

damietta.name: Damietta
damietta.nature_hero: Where Sweet Nile Meets Salt Mediterranean (El-Lesan)
damietta.craft_hook: Egypt's capital of fine woodworking, furniture carving & wooden yacht building
damietta.render_cues: Crisp laminated timber ribs & shaded market arcades, river-mouth reflections, working wooden boatyards

dakahlia.name: Dakahlia
dakahlia.nature_hero: Fertile Delta Waterways & Northern Wetland Fringe
dakahlia.craft_hook: Canal-side timber rowboats, historic Mamluk courtyard joinery
dakahlia.render_cues: Emerald agricultural patchwork, shaded brick courtyards, calm palm-lined riverfront promenades

gharbia.name: Gharbia
gharbia.climate_zone: Mild-warm central Delta buffered by dense crops
gharbia.nature_hero: Central Delta Green Carpet & Dawn Jasmine Fields
gharbia.craft_hook: Shubra Beloula jasmine-oil distillation, El-Mahalla cotton weaving
gharbia.render_cues: Fragrant dawn mist over white jasmine fields, woven mat-courtyard carpets, warm brick-lattice shadows

monufia.name: Monufia
monufia.craft_hook: Sakiet Abu Shara hand-knotted silk & wool carpets, clay pottery
monufia.render_cues: Intimate shaded village courts, natural-dyed textile canopies, lush stepped brick canal landings

sharqia.name: Sharqia
sharqia.climate_zone: Warm eastern Delta transitioning to dry desert corridor
sharqia.nature_hero: Delta-to-Desert Edge, Papyrus Reeds & Migratory Ponds
sharqia.craft_hook: El-Qaramous papyrus sheet crafting, Arabian horse heritage
sharqia.render_cues: Tall green papyrus stalks swaying in breeze, warm sand-and-brick transitions, flat Delta horizon

port_said.name: Port Said
port_said.nature_hero: Suez Canal Mouth & Lake Manzala Bird Wetlands
port_said.render_cues: Crisp white-and-ochre timber verandas, giant ships gliding past palms, misty sea-canal dawn

ismailia.name: Ismailia
ismailia.nature_hero: Lake Timsah, Bitter Lakes & Fragrant Mango Orchards
ismailia.craft_hook: Garden-city veranda design, Simsimiyya folk music
ismailia.render_cues: Shaded tree-lined boulevards, calm lake sails, lush green mango canopies meeting golden canal sands

suez.name: Suez
suez.climate_zone: Dry hot Gulf head with strong steady wind corridor
suez.prevailing_wind: Strong steady N / NNW (9-11 m/s corridor)
suez.nature_hero: Gulf of Suez Marine Corridor & Soaring Raptor Thermals
suez.craft_hook: Historic Red Sea-Nile port heritage, Simsimiyya lute culture
suez.render_cues: Dramatic desert cliffs meeting deep blue Gulf water, crisp marine steel trusses, wind-carved canopies

north_sinai.name: North Sinai
north_sinai.climate_zone: Mediterranean coastal sand-dune desert with mild winters
north_sinai.nature_hero: Lake Bardawil, Zaranik Bird Flyway & Rain-Fed Dune Palms
north_sinai.craft_hook: Bedouin tatreez embroidery, camel-hair weaving, olive/palm stewardship
north_sinai.render_cues: Soft golden dunes dotted with green date palms, silver-blue lagoon horizon, low sand-hugging courts

south_sinai.name: South Sinai
south_sinai.climate_zone: Dual: cool high-altitude granite peaks & warm sunny coral coasts
south_sinai.prevailing_wind: N / NE down Gulf of Aqaba; cool mountain breezes
south_sinai.nature_hero: High-Mountain Oasis Gardens, Coral Reefs & Coastal Mangroves
south_sinai.craft_hook: Gebeliyya Bedouin stone-walled bustan orchards, herbalism, beadwork
south_sinai.render_cues: Rose-granite peaks glowing crimson at sunrise, crystal turquoise reefs, lantern-lit trails under Milky Way

red_sea.name: Red Sea
red_sea.climate_zone: Warm dry desert coast cooled by steady northerly sea winds
red_sea.nature_hero: Fringing Coral Reefs, White Mangroves & Acacia Desert Wadis
red_sea.craft_hook: Ababda/Bishariya jabana coffee ritual, coral-stone coastal houses, leather/beadwork
red_sea.render_cues: Deep cobalt-to-turquoise reef gradients, jagged red-brown granite backdrop, dry-stone walls matching bedrock

new_valley.name: New Valley
new_valley.climate_zone: Hyper-arid oasis basins; hot days, crisp cold winter nights, dark skies
new_valley.nature_hero: Artesian Oasis Springs & Wind-Sculpted Chalk/Dune Seas
new_valley.craft_hook: Mudbrick vaulting (Al-Qasr), clay pottery, palm-frond basketry, sand painting
new_valley.render_cues: Sculpted ochre mudbrick vaults, emerald palms against golden dunes, surreal white chalk under twilight stars

fayoum.name: Fayoum
fayoum.climate_zone: Fertile breezy oasis depression (-43m) cooled by Lake Qarun
fayoum.nature_hero: Terraced Oasis, Desert Waterfalls & Prehistoric Whale Sea Floor
fayoum.craft_hook: Tunis Village glazed pottery, gravity-powered wooden waterwheels (sawaqi)
fayoum.render_cues: Curved whitewashed mudbrick domes over blue lake water, turning wooden waterwheels, amber fossil cliffs

beni_suef.name: Beni Suef
beni_suef.climate_zone: Dry sunny northern Upper Egypt valley
beni_suef.nature_hero: Nile Islands, Alabaster Cliffs & Aromatic Herb Fields
beni_suef.craft_hook: Carved translucent alabaster, handloom klim rugs, chamomile/herb drying
beni_suef.render_cues: Glowing amber alabaster panels in thick stone walls, fragrant riverside herb fields, stepped pyramid horizon

minya.name: Minya
minya.climate_zone: Hot dry summers, crisp sunny winters between cliff and dune
minya.craft_hook: White limestone quarrying & carving, traditional sugarcane molasses mills
minya.render_cues: High white-gold limestone cliffs glowing at sunrise over mirror-calm Nile and emerald sugarcane fields

assiut.name: Assiut
assiut.craft_hook: Tally (silver-and-gold thread tulle embroidery), wood & alabaster craft
assiut.render_cues: Steep pale limestone cliffs framing emerald fields, sparkling geometric metal-mesh shade screens

sohag.name: Sohag
sohag.nature_hero: The Great Nile Bend & Palm Plains
sohag.craft_hook: Akhmim handloom silk/linen weaving on wooden pit-looms
sohag.render_cues: Warm terracotta red-brick and cream-limestone walls, vibrant woven shade canopies, sweeping river curves

qena.name: Qena
qena.craft_hook: Qena qulla & ballas evaporative cooling pottery
qena.render_cues: Evaporative terracotta cooling walls & porous clay screens, golden sandstone reliefs, green sugarcane

luxor.name: Luxor
luxor.climate_zone: Hyper-dry brilliant sun year-round; cool Nile evening breezes
luxor.craft_hook: New Gourna passive-cooling mudbrick vaults, West Bank stone/alabaster carving
luxor.render_cues: Honey-gold cliffs glowing crimson at sunset, stepped horizontal colonnades, breathable mudbrick domes

aswan.name: Aswan
aswan.climate_zone: Warm dry sunny winters, very hot dry summers, zero humidity
aswan.nature_hero: First Cataract Granite Rapids, Tropical Islands & River-Edge Dunes
aswan.craft_hook: Nubian painted courtyard mudbrick, coiled straw basketry, granite masonry
aswan.render_cues: Charcoal basalt plinths with golden sandstone & vibrant Nubian accents, smooth granite boulders in sapphire water

wadi_el_natrun.name: Wadi El-Natrun
wadi_el_natrun.nature_hero: Alkaline Natron Salt Lakes & Desert Monasteries

lake_manzala.name: Lake Manzala & Ashtum El-Gamil
lake_manzala.nature_hero: Largest Delta Lagoon & Migratory Bird Nursery

lake_bardawil_zaranik.name: Lake Bardawil & Zaranik
lake_bardawil_zaranik.nature_hero: Hypersaline Barrier Lagoon & First Bird Entry Gate

galala_zaafarana.name: Galala Plateau & Zaafarana
galala_zaafarana.nature_hero: Cliff-Top Wind Corridor & Soaring Raptor Thermals

siwa_oasis.name: Siwa Oasis
siwa_oasis.nature_hero: Kershef Salt-Earth Basin & Turquoise Salt Pools

black_desert_bahariya.name: Bahariya & Black Desert
black_desert_bahariya.nature_hero: Black Volcanic Cones & Hot Oasis Springs

first_cataract_elephantine.name: First Cataract & Elephantine Island
first_cataract_elephantine.nature_hero: Polished Granite Rapids & Nubian Courtyard Islands

abu_simbel_lake_nasser.name: Abu Simbel, Lake Nasser & Wadi Allaqi
abu_simbel_lake_nasser.nature_hero: Saharan Inland Sea & Acacia Wadi Biosphere
